details:
Project Name: AstroCare – Health Monitoring System for Astronauts

AstroCare is a smart health monitoring system developed to monitor and protect astronauts' health during space missions. It tracks important health parameters such as heart rate, body temperature, oxygen levels, and other health conditions through a digital dashboard. The system displays health information, provides alerts when abnormal values are detected, and helps identify potential health risks.

Benefits: It helps monitor astronauts' health, detect possible medical emergencies early, reduce health risks, and improve safety during long-duration space missions.

Intended Impact: The main aim is to improve astronaut safety and support better healthcare management in space by providing continuous health monitoring and timely alerts.

Tools and Technologies: The project uses HTML, CSS, JavaScript, Python, and API-based backend services, along with a web dashboard. Sensor data can be simulated for demonstration purposes.

Creativity: AstroCare combines space technology and healthcare into a single monitoring platform. Its interactive dashboard, health indicators, alert system, and space-themed interface make it unique.

Factors Considered: We considered astronaut safety, real-time data monitoring, accuracy of health information, user-friendly design, quick alerts, and reliable access to health records.
